context:
Separate deterministic checks from reviewer judgement. Add conservative
tooling where the pattern is structurally detectable, and update review
guidance where semantic context is required.
description:
Follow-up from the PR 719 TODO review L2 audit. The review found defects that
schema validation did not catch:

- mutually exclusive work units encoded as normal pending work, even though the
  TODO lifecycle has no skipped/waived work status;
- verification commands whose shell semantics can produce ambiguous output;
- missing `prior_art` on TODOs that add new modules, file locations, or
  conventions;
- evidence wording that uses one label for different domains, such as local
  Docker host port vs adapter service/container port.

These are review-framework blind spots. Capture them as reusable TODO-review
guardrails so future TODO reviews fail the pattern directly instead of relying
on reviewer memory.

anti_patterns.dont: add a broad skipped status just to paper over mutually exclusive work units.
edit generated skill mirrors directly; update the canonical source if skill guidance changes.
make fragile keyword checks fail large classes of valid TODOs without a clear escape hatch.

deferrals.reason: That would alter TODO lifecycle semantics; this item should first enforce the current model.

preserves.behavior: Existing valid TODOs with normal decision work remain valid.
The current work-unit completion model is not changed unless separately chartered.

prior_art.concept: /Users/joe/.skill-sync/skills/todo/SKILL.md review action — update reviewer guidance through the canonical skill source, not generated mirrors
_project/TODO/main/planning/uat-certification-rerun-ordering-and-gate.yaml — reuse as a positive example with prior_art and concrete verification
_project/TODO_SCHEMA.yaml — reuse existing work/status schema; do not add a skipped status casually
_project/scripts/validate_todo.py — extend for machine-checkable semantic TODO rules when reliable

scope_rules.path_glob: /Users/joe/.skill-sync/skills/todo/SKILL.md for canonical review guidance, followed by make skill-sync

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest -k 'todo and semantic_guardrail' -q
uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/todo_cli.py check-graph && uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/validate_todo.py --all
verifications.description: TODO graph and schema validation remain clean
verifications.expected: graph validation passed and all TODO/DONE files valid

work_units.notes:
Candidate checks: pending work notes that use branch-selection language
without a single completion path; verification commands with known
ambiguous shell constructs; TODOs adding new modules, env vars, file
locations, or conventions without prior_art. Prefer conservative warnings
when false positives are likely.

Add review guidance for same-label/different-domain evidence claims,
especially infrastructure facts like host port vs service port where the
correct fix is explicit modeling rather than forcing one value.
work_units.summary: Update TODO-review guidance for judgement-based guardrails
